title: Duel Decks: Ajani vs. Nicol Bolas: card flavor text

entities.name: Eladamri
entities.description: A leader who hopes that Volrath and his cursed stronghold will one day fall as his people's numbers grow.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: The master of a cursed stronghold whose fall Eladamri hopes for.

entities.name: Cloud Nacatl
entities.description: A group of nacatl that the Claws of Marisi dismiss as contemplative 'soft paws.'

entities.name: Claws of Marisi
entities.description: Aggressive nacatl who pride themselves on stalking, pouncing and drawing blood.

entities.name: Marisi
entities.description: The namesake of the Claws of Marisi.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: A world where grassland can become jungle overnight and hunting grounds change as quickly as the weather.

entities.name: Ertai
entities.description: A teasing figure who jokes at Mirri's expense and comments on the toads of Urborg.

entities.name: Mirri
entities.description: A catlike companion of Ertai who sneers at his teasing.

entities.name: Jazal Goldmane
entities.description: A leonin who speaks of the prosperity of the pride.

entities.name: Yon Basrel
entities.description: An Oran-Rief survivalist who warns against underestimating seemingly docile creatures.

entities.name: Oran-Rief
entities.description: A place whose survivalists include Yon Basrel.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: A city-world remembered by an aged loxodon as once having been different.

entities.name: Ashling
entities.description: A speaker who once knew a creature carved from a dream of wild freedom that could not be leashed.

entities.name: Tel-Jilad
entities.description: A group whose sworn protectors are the trolls.

entities.name: Tangle
entities.description: A place that itself created protectors more fearsome than the trolls.

entities.name: Zaliki of Naya
entities.description: A Naya figure who still senses Ajani's calming presence though he has not returned to the Cloud Forest.

entities.name: Cloud Forest
entities.description: A forest on Naya to which Ajani has not returned.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A leonin planeswalker who speaks of rage followed by fitting vengeance and retribution by claws.

entities.name: Alovnek
entities.description: A Boros guildmage who removes what does not fit his vision of the world.

entities.name: Boros
entities.description: A guild to which the guildmage Alovnek belongs.

entities.name: Naya
entities.description: A shard where ambition and treachery are scarce due to the awe owed to terrestrial gods.

entities.name: Vitu-Ghazi, the City-Tree
entities.description: A great tree whose seeds grow into children that serve the Conclave.

entities.name: Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: The faction served by the children of Vitu-Ghazi.

entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: A place whose toads are slow and unpleasant but useful.

entities.name: House Dimir
entities.description: A guild that secretly takes its share from travelers one coin purse at a time.

entities.name: Izzet
entities.description: A guild whose creations, like weirds, are based on wild contradictions.

entities.name: Undercity
entities.description: A place whose slang includes 'touched by moroii' meaning to grow old.

entities.name: Malcator
entities.description: An executor who sends inadequate creatures to the splicers for innovation.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: A planeswalker dragon who holds that power is the essence of everything and does not distinguish between servants and victims.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: A dark land whose features, including obelisks from the time of Alara, exist only for dark exploitation.

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: The world from whose time the obelisks of Grixis remain.

entities.name: Eliza of the Keep
entities.description: A speaker who muses on choosing loathing, hate or malice.

entities.name: Sedraxis
entities.description: Ruins said to have once been a shining capital, now a blight avoided by the living.

entities.name: Vithia
entities.description: The land in which Sedraxis was once a shining capital.

entities.name: Olcot
entities.description: A Rider of Joffik who describes the ruins of Sedraxis.

events.summary: Ertai teases Mirri by comparing her to a wildcat; she sneers.
events.quote: "Relative of yours?" Ertai teased. Mirri simply sneered.

events.summary: Zaliki notes that Ajani has not returned to the Cloud Forest, though she still senses his presence.
events.quote: "He hasn't returned to the Cloud Forest. But I can still sense his calming presence."

relations.quote: the more I gain hope that Volrath and his cursed stronghold will one day fall.

relations.note: Her children rise in service to the Conclave.
relations.quote: her children rise in service to the Conclave.

relations.note: Once a shining capital in Vithia.
relations.quote: They say the ruins of Sedraxis were once a shining capital in Vithia.

relations.note: The Claws disdain the Cloud Nacatl as passive.
relations.quote: The Cloud Nacatl sit and think, a bunch of soft paws.
